en.longDescription: The younger brother of Ved Xol displayed no aptitude for business. Instead, his enthusiasm for violence and conflict have helped him quickly climb corporate ranks.
en.name: Nako Xol

zh.longDescription: Ved Xol 的弟弟对家族产业毫无兴致。不过，他对暴力和冲突的热情是他在企业中向上爬升的资本。
zh.name: Nako Xol

en.longDescription: Pelna Cade is a skilled technician who graduated with the Xol brothers. Remaining close friends with the family following their military service together, he now works for them to keep the robotics in their service in peak condition.
en.name: Pelna Cade

zh.longDescription: Pelna Cade 是一名技艺高超的技术员，与 Xol 兄弟一起毕业。他跟随 Xol 家族一同进入军旅，并一直是亲密的伙伴。现在他的工作是让队伍中的机器人时刻保有巅峰状态。
zh.name: Pelna Cade

en.longDescription: Ved Xol was nominated to become the head of the Loan Reclamation Division at Anyo Corp. after demonstrating ruthless aptitude within The Index. He has obtained favorable results with his team on many occasions, and is a firm favorite amongst corporate backers.
en.name: Ved Xol

zh.longDescription: 通过在《指数之场》展现出残酷无情的天资，Ved Xol 被提名成为安尤企业的贷款回收部负责人。他与他的队伍多次获得了备受赞许的成果，因此在企业的资助人间有着坚实的拥护。
zh.name: Ved Xol

en.longDescription: The Loan Reclamation Division worked closely with Alad V on several ventures during his tenure on the Corpus Board of Directors. Despite his involuntary retirement, it is speculated that the Xol Brothers still undertake assignments on his behalf. These robots, based on Alad V's own patented designs were delivered as payment for services rendered and only serve to strengthen such suspicions.
en.name: Lockjaw & Sol

zh.longDescription: 在阿拉德 V 就任 Corpus 董事会期间，贷款回收部门曾与之有过数次紧密的合作。尽管他已经非自愿地退出了，传言 Xol 兄弟仍然为他经手任务。这些根据阿拉德 V 专利设计的机器人被送来作为工作的酬劳，这样的情形更加重了人们的猜忌。
zh.name: Lockjaw & Sol

en.description: Charges its target and detonates when threatened
en.name: Nemes

zh.description: 当自身受到威胁时会冲向目标并自爆。
zh.name: 自爆机

en.longDescription: A young and ambitious Anyo Corp. employee, Jad has demonstrated remarkable aptitude for micromanaging machinery. He was promoted to the Robotic Technology Division where he leads the design of new robotics to be utilized by other divisions of Anyo Corp.
en.name: Jad Teran

zh.longDescription: 一名年轻有为的安尤企业员工，Jad 展示出了对机械的惊人微操作天赋。他被提拔到机器人技术部门，在那里他领导设计了新型的机器人供安尤企业的其他部门使用。
zh.name: Jad Teran

en.longDescription: Affectionately known as "Azoth" the Hyena Hg is the latest version of Hyena to be produced at Anyo Corp. This model has been optimized to process Index Points with lethal efficiency.
en.name: Azoth

zh.longDescription: 被亲切地冠以"水银"之名，「鬣狗 汞」是由安尤企业制造的最新型鬣狗机器人。这一型号被优化来处理指数点数，拥有致命的效率。
zh.name: Azoth

en.longDescription: The Index marks the debut of the X-series of the Raptor. This version of armored Osprey doubles as both a mobile accounting system and security detail for the brokers employed by Anyo Corp.
en.name: Raptor RX

zh.longDescription: 《指数之场》见证了 X 系列鱼鹰的首次亮相。这一系列的重甲鱼鹰兼具了移动会计系统和安保的功能，为安尤企业的雇员提供服务。
zh.name: 猛禽 Rx

en.longDescription: A heavily modified model of Denial Bursas, designed for the secure transferral of offline funds. This armored robot protects the financial interests of Anyo Corp.
en.name: Auditor

zh.longDescription: 一台高度改装的守护金流恐鸟，被设计用来保全离线的资金转运。这台带有护甲的机器人保护着安尤企业的经济利益。
zh.name: Auditor

en.longDescription: Jen specialises in corporate espionage and uses the information she gathers to facilitate sudden downturns for her opponents.
en.name: Jen Dro

zh.longDescription: Jen 专长于商业间谍行动，并利用获得的信息协助她令对手陷入突发的经济低迷。
zh.name: Jen Dro

en.longDescription: The Multi-Weapon Assault Moa is equipped with a number of weapons to assist the brokers employed by Zenith Galactical with their endeavors.
en.name: M-W.A.M.

zh.longDescription: 这架装备多种武器的突击恐鸟可以协助由至高银河公司雇佣的掮客，完成他们的事业。
zh.name: M-W.A.M.

en.longDescription: A digital virtuoso, Derim is a capable hacker who applies his trade laundering funds traded through The Index.
en.name: Derim Zahn

zh.longDescription: 一位电子世界的大师，Derim 是一名黑客高手，他通过《指数之场》将洗黑钱得来的资金交易出去。
zh.name: Derim Zahn

en.longDescription: Tia supports her allies by providing them with effective exit strategies when a deal takes a turn for the worse. These strategies often leave the other party with significant medical fees.
en.name: Tia Mayn

zh.longDescription: 当生意变糟时，Tia 通过提供有效的退出策略来支援她的友军。她的策略往往使得对手方面临巨大的医疗费用。
zh.name: Tia Mayn

en.longDescription: As the Chief Officer of the Investor Relations department, Armis pressures investors into accepting Nef Anyo's invitation to The Index. He's also adept at leveraging investor debt to make maximum profit for Anyo Corp.
en.name: Armis Ulta

zh.longDescription: 身为投资人关系部门的总监，Armis 逼迫投资人接受奈富·安尤的邀请进入指数之场。同时他也很擅于利用投资人的债务来为安尤企业创造最大利益。
zh.name: Armis Ulta

en.longDescription: A senior Analysts, Dru addresses all complaints received from colonists in person - with a high-grade, rubedo-lined laser cannon.
en.name: Dru Pesfor

zh.longDescription: Dru 是一名高级分析师。他亲自解决所有来自个殖民地的投诉——用最高端的红晶激光炮。
zh.name: Dru Pesfor

en.longDescription: More than just a broker, Rana is a hostile customer relations specialist. When Investors refuse to pay their debts, they can look forward to a visit from her.
en.name: Rana Del

zh.longDescription: Rana 不只是一名经纪人，更是恶性客户关系领域的专家。当投资人拒绝清还债务时，Rana 就会登门拜访他们。
zh.name: Rana Del

en.longDescription: Designed to execute the 002 Eradication Protocol, this Osprey identifies high-risk brokers and administers injury.
en.name: 002-ER

zh.longDescription: 被设计用来执行 002 肃清协议，这架鱼鹰可以辨识高风险的经纪人和控管伤害。

en.description: A member of the infamous Grustrag Three
en.longDescription:
Grustrag Reconditioning Facility
Inmate Report: Vem Tabook

Vem Tabook, leader of 'The Grustrag Three', was committed after the group slaughtered all fellow marines aboard a troop transport. Evidently, the ship took too long to reach battle and the subject was simply "impatient for the killing". Like his accomplices Shik Tal and Leekter, Tabook suffers from a rare cloning mutation. This makes him highly effective in combat but completely unfit for duty.

RECOMMENDATION: Permanent incarceration for study. The subject's combat ability cannot be ignored. If the subject's aggression can be focused, he may yet prove a useful weapon.

- Doctor Tengus
en.name: Vem Tabook

zh.description: 臭名昭著的GRUSTRAG三霸的成员之一
zh.longDescription:
Grustrag 再生设施
囚犯报告：Vem Tabook

Vem Tabook 是“Grustrag 三霸”的带头者，这三人组在被监禁前了屠杀整艘运兵船的战友们。很明显的，这三人组只是“急于杀戮”，而这艘船来不及赶往战场。Tabook 就如他的同伙 Shik Tal 和 Leekter 一样，深受少见的克隆突变问题所苦。这使他能非常利于进行战斗，但对于自己的职责却完全无法适任。

建议：永久监禁以继续研究，这名囚犯的战斗能力可不能视而不见。如果能将他的攻击倾向集中，将可能成为有力的武器。

－Tengus 博士
zh.name: Vem Tabook

en.description: A member of the infamous Grustrag Three
en.longDescription:
Most Honored Councilor Vay Hek,

The agony treatment has worked! Tests show aggression has been shifted to The Tenno. The Grustrag Three are now ready for release and are eager for your orders.

Please note: fratricide is still an issue. Conditioning did not completely remove violent tendencies toward fellow Grineer. My solution is the Grustrag Bolt. When attached to a subject, this device limits combat effectiveness against all Grineer personnel. The bolt will ensure collateral death is acceptably limited. 

I have produced a surplus of these devices. Perhaps these will also aid you with your problem?

Your Loyal Servant,

Doctor Tengus
Director Grustrag Reconditioning Facility
en.name: Leekter

zh.description: 臭名昭著的GRUSTRAG三霸的成员之一
zh.longDescription:
最受崇敬的议员韦·海克，

痛苦的治疗发挥效用了！测试中显示出 Grustrag 三霸的攻击倾向已转移到 Tenno 身上了。现在他们已准备出动，并渴望您下达命令。

请记住：骨肉相残仍是个问题，目前对三霸的治疗还无法根除残杀同族 Grineer 暴虐倾向。我的解决方式是使用 Grustrag 枷锁。当这副枷锁装置接触到一名对象，可以限制住对所有 Grineer 人员的战斗力，同时也确保了造成的伤亡会在可接受的限制范围以内。

我制造的这些枷锁装置数量有点过剩，也许这能有助于解决您的麻烦？

您的忠实仆人，

Tengus 博士
Grustrag 再生设施主任
zh.name: Leekter

en.description: A member of the infamous Grustrag Three
en.longDescription:
Vay Hek,

Releasing the Grustrag Three? Tell me this rumor is a lie. Tell me you have not forgotten what those defects cost me. Traitors must be eradicated but you think they can be rehabilitated? Arrogance. If it were up to me, Grustrag and everyone in it would be ash. No Doctor can cure disloyalty.

The responsibility for this mistake is yours alone. Trust me, you will bleed regret.

Ruk
en.name: Shik Tal

zh.description: 臭名昭著的GRUSTRAG三霸的成员之一
zh.longDescription:
韦·海克，

放出Grustrag三霸？告诉我这谣言不是真的。告诉我你还记得这些瑕疵品使我损失多少弟兄？叛徒必须要根除才行，而你却认为这三人能恢复成常人一样？太傲慢了。如果是我来处理，我会将Grustrag三霸还有其他所有叛徒化为灰烬。不忠不义是无药可救的。

这项错误的责任你得自行承担。相信我，你会后悔不已。

Ruk
zh.name: Shik Tal

en.description: The pride of the Tusk fleet, the Bolkor is the ideal platform from which to mount ground operations. Equipped with a high capacity rotary cannon, densely plated and with enough space to carry a platoon, the Bolkor holds its own raining down fire and dropping squad after squad at regular intervals.
en.name: Tusk Bolkor

zh.description: 博寇是巨牙舰队的骄傲，是进行地面作战的理想平台。装备有大容量的旋转火炮，并密布装甲，且拥有足够的空间容纳一整个排，博寇具有强大的自持能力，足以定期地降下火雨，并投送一队又一队的人员。
zh.name: 巨牙博寇

en.description: In and out under extreme duress, the Firbolg handles lightning-fast infiltrations/extractions and lazy picket duty with equal aplomb.
en.name: Tusk Firbolg

zh.description: 内外都处于极度的胁迫，不论是闪电般快速的潜入/撤离任务还是慵懒的纠察巡逻，巨牙博格都以同样的泰然来面对。
zh.name: 巨牙博格

en.description: One of the faceless Grineer ranks.
en.longDescription: Born in a tube, raised among numberless thousands, the typical Grineer trooper dies forgotten. A copy of a copy of a copy, they may not be the pinnacle of evolution but what they lack in intelligence they make up for in numbers. Occasionally, however, one genetic aberration will prove itself to be superior, and elevated to the rank of Commander.
en.name: Plains Commander

zh.description: Grineer 众多不知名军衔中的一员。
zh.longDescription: 从试管中出生，和成千上万的芸芸众生一起被养大，他是那种典型的 Grineer 士兵，死后默默无闻。作为复制体的复制的复制，他们也许不是进化的巅峰，但他们智力的不足被数量所弥补。只不过，偶尔一个基因变异会使其变得出众，并被拔擢为指挥官军衔。
zh.name: 平野指挥官

en.description: Fires a devastating heat ray and self destructs.
en.name: Tusk Carabus

zh.description: 放射出具有破坏性的热射线并会自爆。
zh.name: 巨牙甲虫

en.description: A rugged career pilot, bred to survive on the Plains.
en.longDescription: Aerial Commanders share a bond with their machines: equal parts mechanic, driver and soldier. For fast deployment and quick eradication of hostiles, a Skiff team can execute a three-angle assault, raining down hellfire before the enemy knows they're dead.
en.name: Aerial Commander

zh.description: 一名粗犷强健的职业飞行员，生来就是为了在平野上存活。
zh.longDescription: 空中指挥官与他们的机器紧密联结：既是零件技工，也是驾驶员，更是士兵。一支轻型艇小队可以执行三角夹击，进行快速的部署和歼敌，在敌人们意识到死期将至前就可降下地狱之火。
zh.name: 空中指挥官

en.description: Armed with a high-velocity rapid-fire cannon, this armored skiff tears up targets and terrain alike.
en.name: Tusk Command Dargyn

zh.description: 装备有高速速射火炮，这种装甲轻型艇可以一视同仁地将目标和地形撕裂。
zh.name: 巨牙指挥轻型艇

en.description: Agile and quick-witted, as patient as she is cunning.
en.longDescription: The most difficult thing a Grineer sniper will ever have to survive... is testing. With a 98% mortality rate, those that make it through go on to become some of the most feared units in the Grineer forces. The Recon Commander is the cream of this elite batch.
en.name: Recon Commander

zh.description: 灵活而又机敏，她不但狡猾多谋，同时也富有耐心。
zh.longDescription: 一名 Grineer 狙击手最难存活的……就是筛选测试。死亡率高达 98%，那些通过测试的人是 Grineer 军中最令人畏惧的部队。而侦查指挥官则又是精英中的精英。
zh.name: 侦查指挥官

en.description:
Vay Hek's personal favorite, the Devourer is a maximal terror unit. Draped in shreds of the diapause bag that birthed it, this gap-mawed monstrosity barrels toward prey with furious intensity.

Wrist-mounted hooks are welded to elbow joints and hyperpowered by a myotechnological winch system for maximum impact-and-pull.
en.name: Ghoul Devourer

zh.description:
身为韦·海克最爱的作战单位，吞噬者是极为恐怖的存在。那些孕育出他们的休眠袋，现已化为残片，悬挂在他们身上。这种长着血盆大口的怪物会以自己的身体为武器，向猎物发起猛烈冲锋。

配备在他们腰部的钩爪机关已与其肘关节焊死，并且搭配了由肌肉控制的绞索驱动系统，使其冲击与牵引力均可达到极致。
zh.name: 吞噬者尸鬼

en.description:
Known colloquially as the 'drill sergeant', the Auger is fast-grown into its enhancements. As with all Ghouls, no regard is given to the proper development of its higher functions.

Cantilevered leg augments propel the unit toward the fray at speed, while over- and under-mounted extendable drill carriages magnify both reach and penetrating power.
en.name: Ghoul Auger

zh.description:
被俗称为"钻头中士"，钻孔者快速地长入它的增幅装备。同其他所有尸鬼一样，并没有人在意它高级功能的正常发育。

悬臂式的腿部增强装置可以快速地将该单位推入战斗，而上下悬挂的可延展钻头车放大了攻击范围和穿透力。
zh.name: 钻孔尸鬼

en.description: The Expired are Ghouls who have succumbed to malnutrition or environmental poisoning during the early stages of development. Their backup nervous systems continue to drive them forward, however, making them ideal suicide troops.
en.name: Ghoul Expired

zh.description: 除役者是在早期发育阶段营养不良或者受环境毒素影响的尸鬼。它们备用的神经系统继续驱使着它们前进，因此，它们是理想的自杀部队。
zh.name: 除役尸鬼

en.description: So named for its terrifying leer, the Rictus (AKA 'the Sawman') lives to divide and conquer its foes - literally.
en.name: Ghoul Rictus

zh.description: 因它恐怖的邪笑而得名，裂嘴者（也就是"电锯兵"）生来就是为了将敌人分而治之——字面意义上的分而治之。
zh.name: 裂嘴尸鬼

en.description: Whether through aberrant cognition or sheer brutality one specimen always moves to the front of each pack. It is from this individual that the other units take their lead.
en.name: Ghoul Auger Alpha

zh.description: 不管是因为异常的认知能力还是单纯的残暴，总有一个样本会移动到每一群尸鬼的前列。其他的单位以这个样本为引领。
zh.name: 钻孔尸鬼头领

en.description: Charges its target and detonates when threatened
en.name: Nemes

zh.description: 当自身受到威胁时会冲向目标并自爆。
zh.name: 自爆机

en.description: This specimen shows evidence of advanced cognitive abilities and greater, if rudimentary, situational analysis. Cold blooded and ruthless, it is easy to see how this specimen led its pack so ably.
en.name: Ghoul Rictus Alpha

zh.description: 这个样本显示出了高级的认知能力，以及更强的、尽管初等的情景分析能力。冷血而又无情，可以轻易地明白这个样本是如何巧妙地引导它的群落的。
zh.name: 裂嘴尸鬼头领

我被一刀两半而摧毁了，然而，借由雅努斯之钥，虚空呼唤了我，将我引领至此并就此重生。

-沃尔
zh.name: 堕落的沃尔

en.description: The Worm Queen's early presence aboard the Zariman has aided her troops' defenses. Through Reliquary tampering, The Worm Queen has bestowed these troopers with a miniature Kuva Trokar to disrupt transference.
en.name: Kuva Trokarian

zh.description: 蠕虫女皇在「扎里曼号」上的及早出现协助了她的部队做好防御。通过破坏圣物装置，蠕虫女皇赐予了这些骑兵一个微型赤毒锐针来干扰传识。
zh.name: 赤毒锐兵

en.description: Delivers the final judgement of Executioner Nok.
en.name: Deth Carabus

zh.description: 负责给行刑者诺克递交最终裁定。
zh.name: 死亡甲虫

en.description: Restores health to allies.
en.name: Medical Carabus

zh.description: 负责给友军恢复血量。
zh.name: 医疗甲虫

en.description: Summons Hyekka to aid her in battle.
en.longDescription: Not much is known about the mysterious Zura. She appeared in the fighting pits with her Hyekka and carved a bloody path through her opposition. The crowd always roars with pleasure when Zura steps into the fighting pits.
en.name: Executioner Zura

zh.description: 召唤鬣猫来辅助她战斗。
zh.longDescription: 关于神秘的 Zura 没有太多的资料。她和她的鬣猫出现在角斗场，在对抗她的人之中杀出一条血路。当她步入决斗场的时候人群总会有欢呼声。
zh.name: 行刑者 Zura

en.description: An agile combatant without fear.
en.longDescription: The sole survivor of a frontier battalion that was eradicated by a lone Tenno, when Garesh eventually returned to civilization, he was tried as a deserter and sentenced to death by Rathuum. To everyone's surprise he killed all his Executioners and was granted a pardon on the condition that he himself become an Executioner. Garesh yearns for the day when he can punish a Tenno.
en.name: Executioner Garesh

zh.description: 一位无所畏惧的灵活斗士。
zh.longDescription: 作为在边境营地被一名单枪匹马的 Tenno 连根拔起后唯一的幸存者，当加雷什重返文明世界时，死亡角斗场将他审判为逃兵并处以死刑。出乎所有人意料的是，他杀死了所有行刑者，并且被准许成为一名行刑者以免除死罪。加雷什渴望着有朝一日可以对 Tenno 动手处决。
zh.name: 行刑者加雷什

en.description: A cunning combatant that uses machinery to assist him.
en.longDescription: Reth was once a simple labourer working in the shipyards on Ceres. He often wondered how lethal the equipment he worked with could be if he only made minor tweaks to its design. After a series of escalated killings his handiwork was discovered by his superiors. Rather than risk being captured, Reth fled to Kela, where he now field tests his latest machinations in the service of Rathuum.
en.name: Executioner Reth

zh.description: 一位使用机器来辅助他的狡猾斗士。
zh.longDescription: 莱斯过去曾经是一名在谷神星造船厂工作的劳工。他对于手中用于劳务的装备如经过微调改造后，能够有多致命感到十分好奇。经过一系列不断加剧的杀戮行为，他的杰作终于被上级发现。与其冒险被抓，莱斯转向投奔 Kela，莱斯现在服侍着死亡角斗场并在他在麾下测试最新的阴谋诡计。
zh.name: 行刑者莱斯

en.description: An experienced veteran, trained and disciplined.
en.longDescription: Nok led a decorated career in service to Captain Vor, tasked with routing out any weak or anarchic influences within the ranks of the Grineer Army. After many years of loyal service, the degenerative effects that plague all Grineer began taking their toll on Nok. With Vor's blessing, Nok was granted leave to spend his remaining days punishing Grineer in the court of Rathuum.
en.name: Executioner Nok

zh.description: 一位富有经验的老兵，训练有素且严守纪律。
zh.longDescription: 效命于上尉沃尔时，诺克带领着一支粉饰太平的职业。诺克被指派去销毁任何虚弱或是阵线受无政府意识煽动影响的 Grineer 军队。历经长年的忠诚服务后，一直以来困扰且重创了全体 Grineer 的基因衰退问题也降临到诺克身上。在沃尔的庇护之下，诺克被批准纳入死亡角斗场麾下，在惩处 Grineer 中度过余生。
zh.name: 行刑者诺克

en.description: Heals his team with advanced medical technology.
en.longDescription: Once a medical officer under Sargas Ruk, Thul failed to save the life of one of his favoured officers. Thul was “reassigned” to service under Kela as an Executioner of Rathuum. He has managed to survive under the protection of his allies, who value his medical skills.
en.name: Executioner Dok Thul

zh.description: 拥有先进的治疗技术来治愈他的团队。
zh.longDescription: 过去曾在 Sargas Ruk 手下任职医官时，图尔未能成功挽回 Sargas Ruk 所钟爱的成员性命，图尔的职务因此被「重新分配」到 Kela 麾下，成为一名死亡角斗场的行刑者。他依靠盟军的庇护生存下来，因为他们非常看重他的医疗技术。
zh.name: 行刑者多克·图尔

en.description: A resilient combatant who relishes pain.
en.longDescription:
Dhurnam loved to hurt things. As a Grineer officer, he inflicted pain at any possible opportunity. So when he heard about Tyl Regor's experimental body augmentations, he clamored to become a subject. He didn't care about side effects, anything to become stronger.

The experiment left him sluggish and unresponsive. Weak of voice, he whispered for death. Instead, Regor ordered him beaten. The pain brought Dhurnam to life. He became a beast, eviscerating the unfortunate things sent to hurt him. Regor was pleased.

But the experiment was only a partial success. Without pain, Dhurnam grew weak again. Unfit for regular duty, the pits of Rathuum became his new home. The only place where he could find the steady diet of torment and suffering needed to survive.
en.name: Executioner Dhurnam

zh.description: 一名以享受痛苦为乐的好战者。
zh.longDescription:
身为一名 Grineer 军官，热爱伤害事物的杜纳姆握有任何得以造成痛苦的机会。因此当他得知泰尔·雷工要增加实验体时，杜纳姆吵着也要成为一名受测者。他毫不在乎副作用，亦或是变得更强壮这件事情。
 
这场实验使他变得呆滞而迟钝，声音微弱的他低语着死亡。然而雷工下令让人殴打他，这份痛楚带给了杜纳姆新生。杜纳姆成为了一头野兽，抽出那些伤害他的不幸者的内脏，这令雷工感到十分满意。
 
但实验仅取得了部份成功，缺乏痛楚的杜纳姆再次变得虚弱。由于无法常态性值勤，死亡角斗场的死斗场成为了他的新归宿。那里是他得以找到稳定的折磨粮食与生存下去的痛楚的地方。
zh.name: 行刑者 Dhurnam

en.description: Highly maneuverable combatant with devastating attacks.
en.longDescription: In return for a substantial donation to his campaign, Vay Hek consigned one of his most vicious clones to Kela’s service. Vay Molta has become a crowd favorite with her modified Jat Kittag.
en.name: Executioner Vay Molta

zh.description: 拥有毁灭性攻击力的高机动斗士。
zh.longDescription: 作为在竞选活动中获得大量物质捐赠的酬谢，韦·海克委托了他克隆人中最险恶的一名亲信为 Kela 效命。在成功改造喷射战锤之后，Vay Molta 俨然成为众人眼中的闪亮之星。
zh.name: 行刑者 Vay Molta

en.description: A deceptive and cunning combatant.
en.longDescription: Olka Harkonar hails from the Harkonar Production Zone. She is one of the few nobles not satisfied by simply watching her weapons wreak havoc, she needed to join the fray. So Olka Harkonar became an Executioner of Rathuum, vowing to prove the might of Harkonar weapons and armor with every judgement she made.
en.name: Executioner Harkonar

zh.description: 一位擅长狡猾和欺骗的斗士。
zh.longDescription: 奥卡·哈库那出身于哈库那生产区。她是为数不多的贵族之一，仅仅看着她的武器肆虐一切并不能让她得到满足，她需要亲身参与进来。因此她成为了死亡角斗场的行刑者，誓言要通过她每次的行刑来证明哈库那武器与护甲的威力。
zh.name: 行刑者哈库那

en.description: A deceptive and cunning combatant.
en.longDescription: Olka Harkonar hails from the Harkonar Production Zone. She is one of the few nobles not satisfied by simply watching her weapons wreak havoc, she needed to join the fray. So Olka Harkonar became an Executioner of Rathuum, vowing to prove the might of Harkonar weapons and armor with every judgement she made.

en.description: A frontline warrior who protects his allies.
en.longDescription: Gorth was a distinguished commander of the Nightwatch Corps but when he unwittingly killed a close ally of Lech Kril for stealing supplies, he faced political fallout that destroyed his career. Exiled from military service, Gorth now seeks to redeem his honor as an Executioner of Rathuum.
en.name: Executioner Gorth

zh.description: 一位保护他同盟的前线战士。
zh.longDescription: 高斯是一名杰出的夜巡者指挥官。然而当他无意间杀死一名正在行窃补给品的 Lech Kril 亲信后，他面临到政治生涯宣告结束的后果。他从服役的军队中被流放，如今高斯借由成为死亡角斗场的行刑者，意图挽回他的荣耀。
zh.name: 行刑者高斯

en.description: High Damage
en.name: Elite Lancer

zh.description: 高伤害
zh.name: 精英枪兵

It may manifest in three different forms, the Suzerain, Zelator and Anchorite, with a fourth form, the 'Fragmented One', being the most formidable of all. Together, as heralds of the Indifference, they tether down the Strands of Khra down which their bizarre master must travel.

en.description:
"Known and unknowable. This thing has haunted my life, waking and asleep, ever since I made that accursed bargain. A parasite at the core of my city. It drains my wealth, my power, my reactors… and my dignity.

This will not stand. I will see that horrendous thing destroyed.

I will be free."

Alad V
en.name: Ropalolyst

zh.description:
" 已知而不可知。自从我做了那项可憎的协议后，这件事情便日复一日、夜复一夜的困扰着我的人生。犹如我城市核心中的寄生虫，蚕食鲸吞掉我的财务、权利、反应炉，以及我的……身份。

这不会得逞的，我会亲眼见证那可怕的东西被摧毁。

我终将获得自由之身。"

阿拉德 V

zh.description: 重型 Sentient 战斗机，通过切割型等离子波削弱目标，并释放出巨型能量球来终结目标。
zh.name: 离子战机

en.description: Pierces a ship's hull to release a boarding party.
en.name: Splintrix

zh.description: 刺穿一艘战舰的舰体来派出一组登舰小队。
zh.name: 芒刺冲锋艇

en.description: I am your reckoning!
en.longDescription:
Some have walked these desolate worlds while you slept. Some like me. I remember what you did. I remember the day.

The Tenno appeared at the Terminus, gleaming and victorious. Our cold and gold Emperors, breathless, bathed you in savior's silk. Then came the sound. Across all our worlds, all at once, the ceremonial Naga drums. A royal salute to the honored Tenno. Ten solemn beats to declare the suffering was over. I watched from a distance, with the rest of the low Guardians. With each beat terror began to crush my throat. The Tenno were not stoic and silent. They were waiting. They were poised. I tried to call out but only a strangled whisper escaped.

When the ninth beat rang a torrent of blood filled the stadium, loosed by Tenno blades. The drums, the Empire, fell silent forever.

Now I hunt, dividing your numbers. Watching from that dark place, cataloging your sins, I am the ghost of retribution. You may forget but you are not innocent.
en.name: Protector Stalker

zh.description: 我是你的终结者！
zh.longDescription:
在你沉睡时，有些人占据了这荒凉的世界。有些则和我一样，记得你做了什么，记得那一天。

Tenno光耀胜利的身影出现在Terminus。而我们冷静崇高的君王，屏气凝神的以救世主之丝绸为你洗涤。忽然，一道声音随之而来，长胴鼓的鼓声响遍我们的世界，是授予崇敬Tenno的皇家鼓声，以十次庄严的鼓声宣告苦难终于过去。我与其他低阶护卫们从远处看着，我的喉咙似乎被每一道鼓声给压碎。Tenno没有肃静，他们等待已久，蓄势待发。我试着呼救，但只能发出窒息般的低语。

当第九次鼓声响起，无数柱鲜血随着Tenno的刀剑喷涌而出，洒满整座竞技场。从此，鼓声与整个帝国陷入了永远的沉寂。

现在我开始狩猎，从黑暗之处观察你们，纪录你们的罪，再一一除掉你们。我是复仇的幽灵。你可以忘记往日所为，但你绝不是无辜的。
zh.name: 卫护追猎者

zh.name: 焦虑

en.longDescription:
I was cut in half, destroyed, but through its Janus Key, the Void called to me. It brought me here and here I was reborn.

–Vor
en.name: Corrupted Vor

zh.longDescription:
我被一刀两半而摧毁了，然而，借由雅努斯之钥，虚空呼唤了我，将我引领至此并就此重生。

-沃尔
zh.name: 堕落的沃尔

en.description: With each generation, this Techrot predator becomes stronger, evolving new powers and attacks. Evolving these powerful creatures is metabolically costly for the Techrot, could this be exploited to weaken the Infestation?
en.name: Legacyte

zh.description: 随着每一代的进化，这种科腐者捕食者变得越来越强大，进化出新的能力和攻击方式。进化这些强大的生物对科腐者来说需要消耗大量的能量，这一点是否可以利用来削弱 Infestation？
zh.name: 传承种

en.description: On the rare occasions when Murmur fragments assemble themselves into a whole, the result is a monstrous and potent entity. It may manifest in three different forms, the Suzerain, Zelator and Anchorite, with a fourth form, the 'Fragmented One', being the most formidable of all. Together, as heralds of the Indifference, they tether down the Strands of Khra down which their bizarre master must travel.
en.name: The Fragmented Suzerain

zh.description: 在极少数情况下，低语者断肢会组合成一个整体。这种情况下会产生一个强大的怪物。它可能有三种不同的形态：宗主级、信徒级和隐士级，而第四种形态的"接肢至尊"则是其中最可怕的。作为虚空无情之物的使者，它们固定着时间丝线，而它们奇异的主人则必须沿着时间丝线才能前进。
zh.name: 接肢宗主

en.description: A servitor to Albrecht Entrati, she was bound to the protection of Scholar's Landing. However, long years of isolation made her vulnerable to the manipulative whispers of Neci Rusalka. Now, she serves a new master, and attacks anyone who dares set foot on the isle.
en.name: Oraxia

zh.description: 作为阿尔布雷希特·英择谛的侍从，她必须保护儒临地。然而，长年的与世隔绝使她很容易被内奇·鲁莎卡的低语操控。如今，她为一位新主人效忠，胆敢踏足这座岛屿的人都会遭到她的攻击。
zh.name: Oraxia

en.description: Kullervo answers for his sins and the sins of others. His daggers and melee prowess deal high damage. Seize the power of treachery to slake his thirst for revenge.
en.name: Kullervo

zh.description: Kullervo 背负着自己和他人的罪孽。他的匕首和近战能力可以造成高额伤害。抓住背叛的力量来满足他对复仇的渴望。
zh.name: Kullervo

en.name: The Golden Cradle

zh.description: 奥罗金神器需要保护
zh.name: 金色摇篮

en.description: The Arbiters of Hexis created this drone to put Tenno to the test in Arbitrations.
en.name: Arbitration Shield Drone

zh.description: 由均衡仲裁者所制作的无人机，使 Tenno 在裁决中受到考验。
zh.name: 仲裁者神盾无人机

en.description: These helpful Necramites have helped keep Albrecht Entrati's Laboratories in tip top shape while Loid and the Cavia were in stasis.
en.name: Necramite

zh.description: 当洛德和科维兽处于冷冻舱时，这些乐于助人的殁世微灵使阿尔布雷希特·英择谛的实验室保持在最佳状态。
zh.name: 殁世微灵

zh.name: 拟态者

en.description: The pride of the Tusk fleet, the Bolkor is the ideal platform from which to mount ground operations. Equipped with a high capacity rotary cannon, densely plated and with enough space to carry a platoon, the Bolkor holds its own raining down fire and dropping squad after squad at regular intervals.
en.name: Prime Grineer Bolkor

zh.description: 博寇是巨牙舰队的骄傲，是进行地面作战的理想平台。装备有大容量的旋转火炮，并密布装甲，且拥有足够的空间容纳一整个排，博寇具有强大的自持能力，足以定期地降下火雨，并投送一队又一队的人员。
zh.name: Prime Grineer 博寇

en.name: Anarch Grineer Lancer

zh.description: 一名克隆士兵，战斗力处于巅峰状态。枪兵是奥罗金军团的前线，他们不知疲倦地推进，将军队的全部力量深入敌后。枪兵的选拔标准是意志坚定，他们一旦认定某个想法，就很难放弃。

en.description: Only the most cunning of clone stock are chosen to become trappers. These are given training in the operation of Trapper Drones by Archimedea; many do not make it through the training. Trappers are frequently ostracized from their squads due to mishaps while they are learning to aim.
en.name: Anarch Grineer Trapper

zh.description: 只有最狡猾的克隆人才能被选中成为捕猎者。他们会接受科研的训练，学习如何操作捕猎无人机；许多人无法通过训练。由于在学习瞄准过程中容易发生意外，捕猎者经常被小队排斥。

en.name: Trapper Drone

zh.description: 这是 Grineer 捕猎者部署的一种无人机，用于诱捕受害者。它会发射电光束锁定目标，然后用大范围的电流冲击波击晕大片敌人。这种无人机的系统独一无二，与任何其他奥罗金设备都截然不同。

en.description: A Sentient drone deployed from a Hunhullus. Carrionites scan the terrain for enemy units, alerting their lumbering master who will then obliterate them.
en.name: Carrionite

zh.description: 一架由英魂统使部署的 Sentient 无人机。腐生无人机会扫描地形，寻找敌军，并将警报传递给它们笨重的主人，主人随后会将敌军彻底摧毁。
zh.name: 腐生无人机

en.description: Swarming micro-drones deployed from a Sentient Hunhullus. When destroyed Marrowticks have the curious property of creating gravitic fields imbued with Void radiation, a possible consequence of their earlier role in assisting with the construction of the Solar Rail between the Origin System and Tau.
en.name: Marrowtick

zh.description: 成群的微型无人机从 Sentient 英魂统使部署而来。当被摧毁时，骨髓蜱具有一种奇特的特性，即会产生充满虚空辐射的引力场，这可能是它们早期参与建造始源星系和 Tau 星系之间的星际航道所导致的后果。

en.name: Brachiolyst

zh.description: 可以俯冲下来近战攻击的飞行单位。
zh.name: 狂战使

en.description: A deceptive and cunning combatant.
en.longDescription: Olka Harkonar hails from the Harkonar Production Zone. She is one of the few nobles not satisfied by simply watching her weapons wreak havoc, she needed to join the fray. So Olka Harkonar became an Executioner of Rathuum, vowing to prove the might of Harkonar weapons and armor with every judgement she made.
en.name: Knave Specter

zh.description: 一位擅长狡猾和欺骗的斗士。
zh.longDescription: 奥卡·哈库那出身于哈库那生产区。她是为数不多的贵族之一，仅仅看着她的武器肆虐一切并不能让她得到满足，她需要亲身参与进来。因此她成为了死亡角斗场的行刑者，誓言要通过她每次的行刑来证明哈库那武器与护甲的威力。
zh.name: 无赖魅影

en.description: Fast and explodes when near enemies
en.name: Orphid Husks

zh.description: 快速接近并在敌人附近自爆
zh.name: 兰花外皮

en.description: The victim and beneficiary of Parvos Granum's research into Specter Particle Theory, this is all that remains of the Protea Warframe who sacrificed herself to keep Granum safe in a pocket realm beyond time.
en.name: Protea Specter

zh.description: Protea 既是帕尔沃斯·格拉努的"魅影粒子理论"研究的受益者，也是受害者。在完成了自我牺牲，并将格拉努安全地封存在一个超越时间的口袋空间后，这是这个战甲所残存下来的全部痕迹，仅此而已。
zh.name: Protea 魅影

en.description: A servitor to Albrecht Entrati, she was bound to the protection of Scholar's Landing. However, long years of isolation made her vulnerable to the manipulative whispers of Neci Rusalka. Now, she serves a new master, and attacks anyone who dares set foot on the isle.
en.name: Oraxia

zh.description: 作为阿尔布雷希特·英择谛的侍从，她必须保护儒临地。然而，长年的与世隔绝使她很容易被内奇·鲁莎卡的低语操控。如今，她为一位新主人效忠，胆敢踏足这座岛屿的人都会遭到她的攻击。
zh.name: Oraxia

en.description: A servitor to Albrecht Entrati, she was bound to the protection of Scholar's Landing. However, long years of isolation made her vulnerable to the manipulative whispers of Neci Rusalka. Now, she serves a new master, and attacks anyone who dares set foot on the isle.

zh.name: Oraxia

en.description: Spiderlings born from the guardian of Scholar's Landing. Though precious to their mother, an explosively short life leaves only the hunt to bond over.
en.name: Scuttlers

zh.description: 儒临地守护者所生的蜘蛛幼崽。虽然它们对母亲来说弥足珍贵，但生命却异常短暂，只能通过狩猎来维系彼此的羁绊。
zh.name: 急行蛛

en.description: Scuttlers
en.name: Scuttlers

zh.description: 急行蛛
zh.name: 急行蛛

en.description: These aggressive and explosive Scuttlers have one purpose to fulfil in their short lives; protect their mother.
en.name: Death Scuttler

zh.description: 这些具有攻击性且易爆的急行蛛在它们短暂的一生中只有一个目标：保护它们的母亲。
zh.name: 死亡急行蛛

en.longDescription: Many generations ago, in search of a life free from the corrupting influence of greed, the Mycona split from the Corpus. Life was difficult for the new colony, but they proved resourceful by surviving where no one thought possible, among the Infestation. Now, they earn their living harvesting the biological products of the Infested and trading with outsiders. Contact with Mycona is limited, but those that trade with them speak of a strange force capable of pacifying the otherwise ravenous Infested horde. The Myconians call this force, the Triuna.
en.name: Myconian Hunter

zh.longDescription: 数个世代以前，为了追寻不被贪欲腐化的生活，Mycona 人从 Corpus 中分离了出来。起初，新殖民地的生活艰辛，但他们身处感染之中，从不可能的逆境中存活了下来，证明了自身的才智。如今，他们通过获取感染者的生物制品，并与外人贸易谋生。尽管与 Mycona 的联系十分有限，但同他们交易的人都说，Mycona 人拥有一种奇怪的力量，可以使得原本贪食不厌的感染兽群平静下来。那些 Mycona 人将这种力量称之为，圣脉。
zh.name: Mycona 猎手

en.description: The crystalized remains of the master foundry operator, Belric.
en.longDescription:
During the Old War, Belric, Rania and their guardian Warframe Citrine were the last line of defense against a Sentient onslaught upon a strategically important planetoid. In the absence of any eyewitnesses, what happened in those final moments is a matter of speculation and colorful myth. 

What is known? A bio-bomb released the Infestation upon the planetoid, halting the Sentient advance and creating a heavily mutated environment. As for Belric and Rania, the evidence suggests they were turned to crystal by Citrine. In her final moments, the Warframe chose not to flee but to use the last of her energy to preserve the pair, together, in one final embrace.
en.name: Belric's Crystal

zh.description: 铸造大师贝里克的的晶化遗骸。
zh.longDescription:
在远古之战时期，一颗具有重要战略目的的小行星上，贝里克、拉尼娅和守护他们的战甲 Citrine 组成了抵御 Sentient 猛攻最后的防线。但在缺少目击者的当下，最终时刻发生的往事成为了猜测和五彩缤纷的神话故事。

已知的事实呢？由一颗生物炸弹带来的感染物质在小行星上被释放，暂且阻止了 Sentient 的前进，并创造出一片严重变异的环境。至于贝里克和拉尼娅，有证据表明他们被 Citrine 变成了水晶。战甲 Citrine 在最后的时刻，并没有选择逃跑，转而用她最后的能量封存了这对情侣，赐以最终之拥的形态。
zh.name: 贝里克的水晶

en.description: The crystalized remains of the celebrated Void engineer, Rania.
en.longDescription:
In an event that has become the stuff of legend, Rania, along with her former husband Belric, were transmuted into crystal by their sworn protector; the Warframe Citrine. A merciful end, that saved them from a much worse fate.

Their crystals remained together until the recent past. Smugglers discovered they exhibited some very curious properties; when separated, Rania's crystal remains connected to Belric's crystal via a Void tunnel. How? Perhaps in their final moments, intense emotions deformed the Void substrata, connecting them forever. 

Doomed lovers, connected forever. Citrine's last wish.
en.name: Rania's Crystal

zh.description: 著名虚空工程师拉尼娅的晶化遗骸。
zh.longDescription:
在一个已经成为传奇的事件中，拉尼娅和她的前夫贝里克被他们的誓约守护者——Citrine 战甲凝结成了水晶。这是一个仁慈的结局，让他们幸免于更悲惨的命运。

直到不久前，他们的水晶还连在一起。走私者发现它们展示出一些非常奇特的特性；分开后，拉尼娅的水晶仍然通过一个虚空通道与贝里克的水晶相连。怎么会呢？也许在他们二人的最后时刻，强烈的情感让虚空的质基变形，从而将他们永远地连在一起。

命中注定的爱人，永世相连的缠绵。Citrine 的遗愿。
zh.name: 拉尼娅的水晶

en.description: Feral Kubrow
en.longDescription: After the fall of the Orokin, these former pets were left to fend for themselves. Only the most vicious survived, evolving into deadly pack hunters that now pervade every inch of Earth's dense forest. Intensely territorial, the Kubrow will attack any creature unlucky enough to cross their path.
en.name: Tamm

zh.description: 野生库狛
zh.longDescription: 奥罗金帝国衰败后，这些曾经的宠物沦落到自己照顾自己. 它们中只有最恶毒的存活下来，演变成致命的群居狩猎野兽. 现在它们遍布于地球茂密森林中的每一寸土地中. 这片土地因此变得紧张起来，库狛会袭击任何运气不好遇到它们的生物.
zh.name: 塔塔羊

en.description: On the rare occasions when Murmur fragments assemble themselves into a whole, the result is a monstrous and potent entity. It may manifest in three different forms, the Suzerain, Zelator and Anchorite, with a fourth form, the 'Fragmented One', being the most formidable of all. Together, as heralds of the Indifference, they tether down the Strands of Khra down which their bizarre master must travel.
en.name: The Fragmented Suzerain

zh.description: 在极少数情况下，低语者断肢会组合成一个整体。这种情况下会产生一个强大的怪物。它可能有三种不同的形态：宗主级、信徒级和隐士级，而第四种形态的"接肢至尊"则是其中最可怕的。作为虚空无情之物的使者，它们固定着时间丝线，而它们奇异的主人则必须沿着时间丝线才能前进。
zh.name: 接肢宗主

zh.description: 忍力是圣名者誓言号机敏果决的舰长，也是刺客的守护圣徒。凭借锋利的刀刃与更加锋锐的头脑，他驾驭主力舰与 Tenno 并肩杀入战斗，令 Hunhow 大为玩味。
zh.name: 忍力

en.description: Vena steals Ryoku's power to create her own warped Shadow Clones.
en.name: Dread Mirror Clone

zh.description: 维纳窃取了忍力的力量，创造出了她自己扭曲的影分身。
zh.name: 恐惧魔镜分身

en.description: Vena steals Ryoku's power to create her own warped Shadow Clones.
en.name: Dread Mirror Claw

zh.description: 维纳窃取了忍力的力量，创造出了她自己扭曲的影分身。
zh.name: 恐惧魔镜利爪

en.description: Vena, the deadly captain of the Kuva Wytch, commands your respect. Out of boredom, or perhaps for a sadistic love of violence, her capital ship patrols in search of conflict. Underestimate her, and face the wrath of her talons.
en.name: Vena

zh.description: 维纳是赤毒女巫号致命的舰长，令人肃然起敬。也许只是因为无聊，也许是出于对杀伐的残酷迷恋，她驾驶主力战舰四处巡航，寻觅战火。但凡敢轻视她的人，都将直面其利爪之怒。
zh.name: 维纳

en.description: This Sister of Parvos has sworn their loyalty to Vena.

zh.description: 这名帕尔沃斯的姐妹已宣誓效忠维纳。

zh.description: 这些蠕虫般的构造体身披奥罗金的黄金铠甲，黄金喉兽会潜入地底伺机破土而出，伏击并吞噬敌人。

en.description: Grineer shock trooper. Carries a huge blade.

zh.description: 一名 Grineer 冲锋艇登舰小队的成员。使用能够发射跳射投射物的锯齿武器。

zh.description: 高克斯塔战舰的指挥官。持有一把卡拉克·亡魂，并具有生成滚子哨兵的能力。

zh.description: 一种食腐鸟类，也是机会主义的猛禽。秃鹰会聚集在一起，以腐肉为食，偶尔也会以"亲卫队"为名的群体进行狩猎。几个亲卫队会由一位帝王带领。
zh.name: 游荡秃鹰

en.description: An evasive Vulpaphyla that prefers to run away from fights. Its skills are so profound it can even impart them to their master.
en.name: Sly Vulpaphyla

zh.description: 狐帕菲拉性格狡猾，喜欢逃避战斗。其技巧高超到足以传授给主人。
zh.name: 狡黠狐帕菲拉

en.description: An evasive Vulpaphyla that prefers to run away from fights. Its skills are so profound it can even impart them to their master.
en.name: Sly Vulpaphyla

zh.description: 狐帕菲拉性格狡猾，喜欢逃避战斗。其技巧高超到足以传授给主人。
zh.name: 狡黠狐帕菲拉

en.description:
This hardy creature has a collagenous dermis that acts as a thick, protective armor.

Active only while Fass watches over the Cambion Drift.
en.name: Panzer Vulpaphyla

zh.description:
这种强壮的生物有一层厚实的胶原皮层，来充当保护性护甲。

只有在"混乱"监视魔胎之境时才会活动。
zh.name: 铁甲狐帕菲拉

en.description:
Tactically infectious, this Vulpaphyla weakens enemies to future attacks by inflicting <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>Viral Status Effects.

Active only while Fass watches over the Cambion Drift.
en.name: Crescent Vulpaphyla

zh.description:
从战术上来说，这种狐帕菲拉具有传染性，它通过造成 <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>病毒异常状态来削弱敌人，为后续攻击创造优势。

仅在"混乱"期间的魔胎之境出现。
zh.name: 月刃狐帕菲拉

en.description: This large arthropod is generally found flying around Deimos’ several grottos.
en.name: Green Velocipod

zh.description: 这种大型节肢动物通常被发现飞行于火卫二的几个洞穴中。
zh.name: 绿色迅敏节虫

en.description: The fastest variety of Velocipod, it tends to favor the swamplands.
en.name: White Velocipod

zh.description: 迅敏节虫速度最快的品种，它们往往偏爱沼泽地。
zh.name: 白色迅敏节虫

en.description: A sluggish highlands insect that’s capable of bursts of speed when threatened.
en.name: Purple Velocipod

zh.description: 一种行动迟缓的高原昆虫，在受到威胁时可以爆发出惊人的速度。
zh.name: 紫色迅敏节虫

en.description: A sluggish highlands insect that’s capable of bursts of speed when threatened.
en.name: Purple Velocipod

zh.description: 一种行动迟缓的高原昆虫，在受到威胁时可以爆发出惊人的速度。
zh.name: 紫色迅敏节虫

en.description: The most abundant variety of Cryptilex, this aggressive insect will slash anything it deems a threat.
en.name: Burrowing Cryptilex

zh.description: 数量最庞大的隐疾虫变种，这种虫的攻击性会让它斩断任何它认为有威胁的东西。
zh.name: 穴居隐疾虫

en.description: The most abundant variety of Cryptilex, this aggressive insect will slash anything it deems a threat.
en.name: Burrowing Cryptilex

zh.description: 数量最庞大的隐疾虫变种，这种虫的攻击性会让它斩断任何它认为有威胁的东西。
zh.name: 穴居隐疾虫

en.description: The most dangerous Cryptilex. They have glands in their abdomens that can emit an acidic spray.
en.name: Caustic Cryptilex

zh.description: 最危险的隐疾虫。它们的腹部有可以喷出酸雾的腺体。
zh.name: 腐蚀隐疾虫

en.description: This infectious insect is capable of hazardous viral attacks when alerted.
en.name: Septic Cryptilex

zh.description: 这种虫的传染性可以让它在警觉时进行危险的病毒攻击。
zh.name: 脓化隐疾虫

en.description: A prehistoric bird-like creature that often congregates in small groups.
en.name: Common Avichaea

zh.description: 一种经常小群聚集的史前类鸟生物。
zh.name: 常见古羽鸟

en.description: A prehistoric bird-like creature that often congregates in small groups.
en.name: Common Avichaea

zh.description: 一种经常小群聚集的史前类鸟生物。
zh.name: 常见古羽鸟

en.description:
The rarest of Avichaeas, the Viscid produces a thick, tar-like mucus that it discharges when imperiled.

Active only while Fass watches over the Cambion Drift.
en.name: Viscid Avichaea

zh.description:
最罕见的古羽鸟，在受到威胁时会产生并放出一种类似焦油的浓稠粘液。

只有在"混乱"监视魔胎之境时才会活动。
zh.name: 粘质古羽鸟

en.description:
This capricious avian unleashes swarms of infested spores as its primary defense mechanism.

Active only while Vome watches over the Cambion Drift.
en.name: Sporule Avichaea

zh.description:
这种反复无常的鸟类可以释放出成群的感染孢子，作为其主要的防御机制。

只有在"秩序"监视魔胎之境时才会活动。
zh.name: 孢子古羽鸟

en.description: A distinctly Deimosian grotesquerie that attacks its opponents from above.
en.name: Amethyst Nexifera

zh.description: 明显带有火卫二特征的怪兽，会从上方攻击它的对手。
zh.name: 紫晶悬匿兽

en.description: A distinctly Deimosian grotesquerie that attacks its opponents from above.
en.name: Amethyst Nexifera

zh.description: 明显带有火卫二特征的怪兽，会从上方攻击它的对手。
zh.name: 紫晶悬匿兽

en.description: Due to its remarkable strength, this Nexifera can cause seismic shocks when hitting the ground.
en.name: Scarlet Nexifera

zh.description: 由于其非凡的强度，这种悬匿兽在撞击地面时可以引起地震冲击。
zh.name: 猩红悬匿兽

en.description: The Viridian Nexifera can produce a cloud of poisonous gas that’s always best avoided.
en.name: Viridian Nexifera

zh.description: 铬绿悬匿兽会产生一团毒气，最好避开为上。
zh.name: 铬绿悬匿兽

en.description: Unlike most of the highly aggressive life on Deimos, the Vizier Predasite prefers to avoid direct conflict and will instead disable foes from afar. A pack creature, it sheds restorative spores to aid those it considers kin.
en.name: Vizier Predasite

zh.description: 与火卫二上大多数极具攻击性的生物不同，宰相扑猎达赛更喜欢避免正面交战，而是从远处击退敌人。作为群居生物，它会释放治愈孢子来帮助那些它认为是同伴的个体。
zh.name: 宰相扑猎达赛

en.description: Unlike most of the highly aggressive life on Deimos, the Vizier Predasite prefers to avoid direct conflict and will instead disable foes from afar. A pack creature, it sheds restorative spores to aid those it considers kin.
en.name: Vizier Predasite

zh.description: 与火卫二上大多数极具攻击性的生物不同，宰相扑猎达赛更喜欢避免正面交战，而是从远处击退敌人。作为群居生物，它会释放治愈孢子来帮助那些它认为是同伴的个体。
zh.name: 宰相扑猎达赛

en.description: A strong and highly aggressive subspecies that can engage groups of enemies with its <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>Viral jaws and incapacitating spores.
en.name: Medjay Predasite

zh.description: 一种强大且极具攻击性的亚种，可以用其带有 <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>病毒的下颚和使人丧失行动能力的孢子与成群的敌人交战。
zh.name: 守卫扑猎达赛

en.description: The Pharaoh Predasite prefers to leave as much of the fighting to its master as possible, empowering their master's weapons while making enemies more vulnerable to attacks.
en.name: Pharaoh Predasite

zh.description: 法老扑猎达赛喜欢尽可能将战斗交给主人，自己则专注于增强主人的武器，同时使敌人更容易受到攻击。
zh.name: 法老扑猎达赛

en.description: A shy, bizarre-looking, semi-aquatic creature that seldom attacks unless provoked.
en.name: Umber Undazoa

zh.description: 一种害羞且看起来有些怪异的半水生生物，只有在被激怒的情况下才会主动攻击。
zh.name: 深棕水螅履虫

en.description: A shy, bizarre-looking, semi-aquatic creature that seldom attacks unless provoked.
en.name: Umber Undazoa

zh.description: 一种害羞且看起来有些怪异的半水生生物，只有在被激怒的情况下才会主动攻击。
zh.name: 深棕水螅履虫

en.description:
The Howler is easily startled. Its penetrating scream will cause other, more dangerous animals to investigate.

Active only while Vome watches over the Cambion Drift.
en.name: Howler Undazoa

zh.description:
尖啸水螅履虫很容易受到惊吓。其受惊时发出的刺耳尖啸会吸引其他更危险的动物前来一探究竟。

只有在"秩序"监视魔胎之境时才会活动。
zh.name: 尖啸水螅履虫

en.description:
The Vaporous Undazoa gets its name from the noxious gas it belches out when alerted.

Active only while Fass watches over the Cambion Drift.
en.name: Vaporous Undazoa

zh.description:
幻雾水螅履虫的命名灵感，源自其会在受到威胁时释放出有毒气体的特性。

只有在"混乱"监视魔胎之境时才会活动。
zh.name: 幻雾水螅履虫

en.description: Kexats hunt Paragrimms and Rablits and love to be pampered.
en.name: Kexat

zh.description: 可娃猎杀幽幽鹰与兔纸，并且喜欢被人宠爱。
zh.name: 可娃

en.description: Kexats hunt Paragrimms and Rablits and love to be pampered.
en.name: Kexat

zh.description: 可娃猎杀幽幽鹰与兔纸，并且喜欢被人宠爱。
zh.name: 可娃

en.description: This horned rabbit-like creature is much friendlier than its expression seems to suggest.
en.name: Rablit

zh.description: 这种有角的兔子模样的生物比它的表情所传达的要友善很多。
zh.name: 兔纸

en.name: Tamm

zh.description: 塔塔羊喜欢柔软的草地、新鲜的水源和陪伴。幸运将眷顾那些为塔塔羊提供喜爱之物的牧羊者。
zh.name: 塔塔羊

en.description: Krubies are fiercely loyal. They do not hesitate to risk their own safety for the good of their pack.
en.name: Krubie

zh.description: 库贝非常忠诚。它们会毫不犹豫地为了自己的族群而舍弃个体的安危。

en.name: Kubrodon

en.description: The Stover is a kind of proto-Kubrow, resurrected as Venus thawed. When grouped in a pack Stovers are relentless opponents.
en.longDescription: "Because they're dumb as a stove, run hot and because having one on top of you is gonna ruin your day. You walk into a cave system that feels too warm, get out." - Unknown Solaris Rig Jockey.
en.name: Stover

zh.description: 炽托法是一种原型库狛，随着金星解冻而复活。当炽托法成群时，它们是无情的对手。
zh.longDescription: "因为它们笨的像个炉子，总是过热，而且因为如果你碰上了，你一整天就算是毁了。如果你走进一个山洞，感觉有点暖，那就赶紧退出来。"— 不具名的索拉里斯技工
zh.name: 炽托法

en.description: An avian of ridiculous appearance found along coastal regions and around large bodies of water. Mergoo circle and squawk at the sight of marine predators. Many an Ostron fisher owes their life to these odd little birds. Killing one is considered very bad luck.

zh.description: 在沿海地区和大片水域周围发现的一种有着荒谬外表的鸟类。Mergoo 在看到海洋掠食者时会绕圈飞并发出嘎嘎声。多亏了这些奇怪的小鸟许多 Ostron 渔民保住了性命。杀一只是会被认为是凶兆。

en.description: Favoring thunder, lightning and cratered-out areas Bolarolas are all about defense. Their armored plates protect them from most predators, tucking-and-rolling to make good their escape.
en.name: Bolarola

zh.description: 喜欢打雷、闪电和多坑的区域，波雷罗拉的特点就是防御。它们护甲般的外壳可以保护它们免于大多数掠食者之手，缩起来滚走让它们很善于逃跑。
zh.name: 波雷罗拉

en.description: Sleek and silky, the adorable appearance of the Venusian Virmink belies its aggressive demeanor. Favoring rocky landscapes Virmink packs nose the air, scenting for Pobbers - their primary food source.
en.name: Virmink

zh.description: 手感光滑，金星弗鸣克的可爱外观掩盖了它的攻击性。喜欢岩石地形，成群的弗鸣克嗅着空气，寻找泡博的气味——那是它们的主要食物来源。
zh.name: 弗鸣克

en.description: Found near bodies of water the Horrasque subsists primarily upon fish. This hideous creature is terrible to behold, but will not attack unless provoked. When it does its roar will shake the bowels of even the most steadfast trapper.
en.name: Horrasque

zh.description: 在水体附近可以找到，惑瓦斯克主要靠鱼类维生。这种可怕的生物看起来非常恐怖，但除非被激怒就不会攻击。当它吼叫时，连最坚定的兽夹师都会抖三抖。
zh.name: 惑瓦斯克

en.description: Native to the fungal forests of Venus, the Pobber is a skittish rodent possessed of an objectionable odor. Always found in groups they flee at the slightest hint of trouble. They are a primary food source for Virmink and Sawgaw.
en.name: Pobber

zh.description: 金星菌类森林的居民，泡博是有着讨厌气味的胆小啮齿类。总是成群行动，一旦发现一点点问题就四散逃窜。它们是弗鸣克和梭歌的主要食物。
zh.name: 泡博

zh.description: 金星菌类森林的居民，泡博是有着讨厌气味的胆小啮齿类。总是成群行动，一旦发现一点点问题就四散逃窜。它们是弗鸣克和梭歌的主要食物。
zh.name: 精巧泡博

en.description: The Vasca strain is a symbiotic blood-borne virus transmitted via the saliva of infected Kavats. Existing solely to propagate itself the virus makes the host increasingly dependent upon the ingestion of blood, thereby spreading itself further and faster through the population. Vasca-infected kavats, over time, lose all sense of themselves becoming increasingly cunning, violent and ravenous.
en.name: Vasca

zh.description: 噬血病毒菌株是一种通过感染的库娃的唾液，来传播的共生血源性病毒。其存在的目的仅仅是为了通过使宿主越来越依赖于血液的摄入，从而让自身在族群中传播的速度越来越快。随着时间的流逝，受噬血型病毒感染的库娃将会失去自我意识，变得越来越狡猾、暴力和贪婪。
zh.name: 噬血型

en.description: Feral Kubrow
en.longDescription: After the fall of the Orokin, these former pets were left to fend for themselves. Only the most vicious survived, evolving into deadly pack hunters that now pervade every inch of Earth's dense forest. Intensely territorial, the Kubrow will attack any creature unlucky enough to cross their path.
en.name: Kubrow

zh.description: 野生库狛
zh.longDescription: 奥罗金帝国衰败后，这些曾经的宠物沦落到自己照顾自己. 它们中只有最恶毒的存活下来，演变成致命的群居狩猎野兽. 现在它们遍布于地球茂密森林中的每一寸土地中. 这片土地因此变得紧张起来，库狛会袭击任何运气不好遇到它们的生物.
zh.name: 库狛

en.longDescription: Kavats are engineered from genetic strains taken from their hyekka and feral kavat descendants.
en.name: Kavat

zh.longDescription: 库娃是通过由鬣猫和野生库娃的后代的遗传因子设计改良出来的品种。
zh.name: 库娃

en.description: Pet Kubrow
en.longDescription: Kubrow are hatched from eggs grown in the Incubator. Kubrow Eggs can be found in Kubrow Dens on Earth or purchased in the Market.
en.name: Kubrow

zh.description: 宠物库狛
zh.longDescription: 库狛蛋在孵化器中孵化出库狛。库狛蛋可以在地球上的库狛兽穴中找到，或在商店中购买。
zh.name: 库狛

en.description: The pride of the Tusk fleet, the Bolkor is the ideal platform from which to mount ground operations. Equipped with a high capacity rotary cannon, densely plated and with enough space to carry a platoon, the Bolkor holds its own raining down fire and dropping squad after squad at regular intervals.
en.name: Tusk Bolkor

zh.description: 博寇是巨牙舰队的骄傲，是进行地面作战的理想平台。装备有大容量的旋转火炮，并密布装甲，且拥有足够的空间容纳一整个排，博寇具有强大的自持能力，足以定期地降下火雨，并投送一队又一队的人员。
zh.name: 巨牙博寇

en.name: Atomicycle

zh.longDescription: 原子摩托车融合了泽威拉尖端工程技术与公路驾驶的永恒精神。拥有直列四缸引擎和注重运动性能的几何设计，此外还有专属的英择谛虚空调校定制功能。
